slides.label: Unlabeled
slides.text:
Theme: BREAKING NEW GROUND
Texts: Isaiah 42:9; Isaiah 43:19; Revelation 21:5a

slides.label: Unlabeled
slides.text: Breaking new ground means moving beyond the familiar into the new territory God is leading us toward. It means refusing to remain where we have always been when God is calling us forward.

slides.label: Unlabeled
slides.text: Breaking new ground is not simply changing our location; it is responding to God’s new work with faith, courage, and obedience.

slides.label: Unlabeled
slides.text:
B. Dimensions of Breaking new ground
1. GOD DECLARES THE NEW — Isaiah 42:9
2. GOD CREATE AND DEVELOP THE NEW — Isaiah 43:19
3. GOD COMPLETES THE NEW — Revelation 21:5a

slides.label: Unlabeled
slides.text:
C.  OUR ROLE:
1.Hear the call: Gen 2:1-4
2.Believe him beyond where you are or have been.
3.	Step into the new and the old
4.	Possess the new purpose.
5.	Keep going or doing it; perseverance.

slides.label: Unlabeled
slides.text:
Conclusion
Breaking new ground means you must
Believe what God declares,
Step into what God opens and 
Keep going until God completes His purpose.

songs.title: Jesus Love Even Me
songs.artist: Emily S. Oakey & P. P. Bliss

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.text:
I am so glad that our Father in heaven
Tells of His love in the Book He has given;

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.text:
Wonderful things in the Bible I see,
This is the dearest, that Jesus loves me.

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves me, Jesus loves me;
I am so glad that Jesus loves me,
Jesus loves even me.

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.text:
Though I forget Him and wander away,
Kindly He follows wherever I stray;

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.text:
Back to His dear loving arms would I flee,
When I remember that Jesus loves me.

slides.label: Verse 3
slides.text:
O, if there's only one song I can sing,
When in His beauty I see the great King,

slides.label: Verse 3
slides.text:
This shall my song in eternity be:
O, what a wonder that Jesus loves me!

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.text:

so loved He the world that He gave us His Son,

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.text:

and opened the life-gate that all may go in.

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:
Praise the Lord, praise the Lord,
let the earth hear His voice!

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:

and give Him the glory, great things He hath done.

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.text:
O perfect redemption, the purchase of blood,

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.text:
the vilest offender who truly believes,
that moment from Jesus a pardon receives.

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:

slides.label: Verse 3

and great our rejoicing through Jesus the Son;

slides.label: Verse 3
slides.text:
but purer, and higher, and greater will be
our wonder, our transport, when Jesus we see.

slides.label: Refrain

slides.label: Refrain

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.text:
On a hill far away stood an old rugged cross,
the emblem of suffering and shame;

slides.label: Verse 1
slides.text:
and I love that old cross where the dearest and best
for a world of lost sinners was slain.

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:
So I'll cherish the old rugged cross,
till my trophies at last I lay down;

slides.label: Refrain
slides.text:
I will cling to the old rugged cross,
and exchange it some day for a crown.

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.text:
O that old rugged cross, so despised by the world,
has a wondrous attraction for me;

slides.label: Verse 2
slides.text:
for the dear Lamb of God left his glory above
to bear it to dark Calvary. [Refrain]

slides.label: Verse 3
slides.text:
In that old rugged cross, stained with blood so divine,
a wondrous beauty I see,

slides.label: Verse 3
slides.text:
for 'twas on that old cross Jesus suffered and died,
to pardon and sanctify me. [Refrain]

slides.label: Verse 4
slides.text:
To that old rugged cross I will ever be true,
its shame and reproach gladly bear;

slides.label: Verse 4
slides.text:
then he'll call me some day to my home far away,
where his glory forever I'll share. [Refrain]
